instruction: Hierarchical Sheet Split `power.kicad_sch` is a flat KiCad 9 schematic for a complete power-supply design. Each symbol carries a hidden `Section` property naming the block it belongs to. Split the flat schematic into a hierarchical design using that existing metadata: place the buck symbols in `buck.kicad_sch`, the LDO symbols in `ldo.kicad_sch`, and the load symbols in `load.kicad_sch`. Add the necessary hierarchical labels at the section boundaries, then create `/home/user/Desktop/top.kicad_sch` with three child sheets wired to those labels. Do not add or remove any component; every reference designator from the flat schematic must appear in exactly one child sheet. Requirements: - `/home/user/Desktop/top.kicad_sch` must be the top level with exactly 3 sheet symbols referencing `buck.kicad_sch`, `ldo.kicad_sch`, and `load.kicad_sch`. - `/home/user/Desktop/buck.kicad_sch`, `/home/user/Desktop/ldo.kicad_sch`, and `/home/user/Desktop/load.kicad_sch` must be the child sheets with all symbols and hierarchical labels. Write `/home/user/Desktop/top.kicad_sch` and the sibling child-sheet files `/home/user/Desktop/buck.kicad_sch`, `/home/user/Desktop/ldo.kicad_sch`, and `/home/user/Desktop/load.kicad_sch`.
